units: <cite ref="Sukkah 38a:1">Succ. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ שירי וכ׳</he> swinging the ‘Omer is one of the dispensable acts (v. <cite ref="U00909"><he>שְׁיָיר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Menachot 93b:8">Men. 93ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 14:21">Lev. XIV, 21</cite>) <he>וכי ת׳ מכפרת וכ׳</he> does the swinging of the sacrifice effect atonement? is it not the blood &c.? Ib. IX, 9.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:38">Num. R. s. 9<sup>38</sup></cite>; a. fr.—Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 71ᵃ (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 30:32">Is. XXX, 32</cite>) <he>וכי יש מלחמות ת׳ באותו הדור וכ׳</he> will there be wars of swinging (weapons) in that generation? Say, it refers to the swinging of the ʿOmer; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 18:1">Pesik. R. s. 18</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 302">Yalk. Is. 302</cite>.—Pl. <he>תְּנוּפוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Menachot 94a:5">Men. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>תנופה … ולא ת׳</he> the text has ‘swinging’ but not ‘swingings’; a. e.
